headline: Computer Systems Engineering Student • UI/UX Designer & Front-End Developer | C++, Java, JavaScript, Figma | PowerPoint Presentation Expert

sections.bio:
I am an enthusiastic Computer Systems Engineering student at QUEST, Nawabshah, with a strong interest in Front-End Development and UI/UX Design. I am currently working as a UI/UX Intern at Roguenova Solutions, where I gain hands-on experience designing intuitive user interfaces and enhancing overall user experiences.

My technical skill set includes C++, Java, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, SQL, and Figma. I have a solid foundation in Object-Oriented Programming, supported by academic coursework in Data Structures & Algorithms and Digital Logic Design, which has strengthened my analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.

I am passionate about building impactful digital solutions and have a strong ability to present complex ideas through clear, professional PowerPoint presentations. I am continuously working to expand my front-end development expertise, contribute to innovative projects, and collaborate with driven, like-minded professionals.

Feel free to connect if you’re looking for a motivated front-end developer or UI/UX designer, or if you’d like to discuss technology, design, or new opportunities.

This project is a complete full-stack web application featuring a modern, responsive frontend and a powerful Admin Panel (CMS) that allows administrators to manage the entire website without modifying any code.
✨ Key Features
✅ Modern & Responsive UI/UX
 ✅ Secure Authentication & Admin Dashboard
 ✅ Complete Content Management System (CMS)
 ✅ Services, Portfolio, News, Videos & Gallery Management
 ✅ Career Opportunities & Job Application Management
 ✅ Contact Inquiries & Quote Request Management
 ✅ Newsletter Subscription Management
 ✅ Client Statistics & Happy Clients Management

This was one of the two projects I independently designed and developed during my internship, where I was responsible for both the frontend and backend development. Building this application strengthened my skills in full-stack development, database design, authentication, CRUD operations, and creating scalable admin dashboards for real-world business requirements.
I'm grateful to my mentors and teammates for their guidance and support throughout this internship. Every project has been an opportunity to learn, improve, and grow as a developer.
Looking forward to building more impactful and scalable web applications in the future! 🚀

🚀 Web Dev Series – Day 11: Event Listeners
Today, I explored one of the most important concepts in JavaScript​: Event Listeners — the mechanism that makes websites interactive and responsive to user actions.
Every click, scroll, key press, or form submission on a webpage is handled through event listeners, enabling applications to react dynamically and create engaging user experiences.
🔹 Key concepts covered:
 ✅ User Events (click, scroll, keydown, submit)
 ✅ addEventListener()
 ✅ Event-Driven Programming
 ✅ Connecting User Actions with Functions
 ✅ Dynamic DOM Updates
 ✅ Building Interactive User Interfaces
One of the biggest takeaways from this topic is understanding how JavaScript acts as the bridge between user interactions and webpage behavior. Event listeners allow developers to transform static pages into dynamic applications that respond instantly to user input.
From navigation menus and form validation to real-time updates and interactive dashboards, event listeners play a crucial role in modern web development.
As I continue my Web Development journey, I’m gaining a deeper understanding of how JavaScript powers the interactive experiences we use every day.
💻 Technology Stack: HTML, CSS, JavaScript
 🎯 Goal: Building modern, user-centric web applications
